failure_before: A recv_bytes OSError for an oversized AF_PIPE frame escaped serve_once and could terminate the listener loop.
red_observed: Before the fix the test raised OSError(message too long).
implementation: Catch OSError/EOFError only around recv_bytes, close that connection in finally, and return without a fabricated response; listener ownership and other send/handler errors remain unchanged.
full_regression: V4 core 192/192 PASS; GUI bridge 498/498 PASS
acceptance: This proves bounded local transport behavior only; it does not prove a production Named Pipe listener or ChatGPT connector is registered.
